title: Let’s review what we learned
intro: Iman, the attributes of Allah, the unseen, the books, the messengers and the Last Day – let’s repeat it all.

learn.html: We have learned the six pillars of iman. Answer these questions with your muallim, then do the activities below.

items: What are the strict Islamic duties (fard)? What are the wajibs?
What does the first pillar of iman include?
What does belief in tawhid include?
What does belief in the ghayb – the unseen – include?

learn.text: Make a table of the attributes of Allah

items: Besides the main Islamic duties, there are other acts at the level of ________. Allah commanded them, but not as strictly as the fard.
The angel Jibril asked Muhammad (SAW): “Tell me about ________.” He answered: “That you worship Allah as if you ________ Him, for if you do not ________ Him, He surely ________ you.”
Knowledge of the ghayb belongs only to ________ – He alone holds the keys of all secrets. Only He knows this and the ________ world.
A believer knows what has ________ them, but does not know what ________ them.

learn.text: In a few sentences, write the most important thing you learned

practice.title: Match the sin and the person
True or false?
practice.prompt: Tap every sentence that is TRUE, then tap Check.

options.text: Al-Asma’ al-Husna are attributes of Allah.
Jinn and shayatin are unseen beings.
The scrolls and the great books are revelations from Allah.
The Qur’an was revealed to the last Prophet (SAW).

options.why: A mu‘jizah is a supernatural event – the work of Allah.

options.text: The Isra is the journey up to the heavens.
options.why: The Isra is the night journey from Makkah to Jerusalem; the Mi‘raj is the rising through the heavens.

options.text: The Mi‘raj is the journey from Makkah to Jerusalem.
options.why: That is the Isra. The Mi‘raj is the rising through the seven heavens.

pairs: They passed on the revelation completely

options: Where souls stay from death until the resurrection
The scales on which deeds are weighed

questions.q: What is the sixth pillar of iman?
options: Belief in Allah’s decree, good and bad

questions.q: What is the greatest miracle of Muhammad (SAW)?
What was made a duty on the Mi‘raj?
